purpose: User-requested feasibility assessment of the mathematical representation and generator reports. Finite exact description grammar; no corpus or production qualification.

grammar.length: Elias gamma(n), n in {16,256} in this screen; retained original bit length includes leading zeros
grammar.rational: 10 + gamma(w) + w-bit numerator p + w-bit denominator q; reduced 0<=p<q; w=bit_length(q); target=floor(2^n*p/q)
grammar.power: 110 + 2-bit exponent selector k-2 (k=2..5) + ceil(n/k)-bit base a + signed residual code; target=a^k+d
grammar.signed_residual: 0 for zero; otherwise 1 + sign bit (1=negative) + gamma(abs(d))
grammar.generated: 1110 + 2-bit seed + 4-bit bit-offset + 2-bit mask selector; SHAKE256(b'CIX-feasibility-v1:' + one-byte seed), MSB-first; masks zero/all-one/alternating01/alternating10
grammar.direct_mask: 1111 + 2-bit mask selector with the same mask family and no generated reference
grammar.padding: Zero padding to the next byte; decoder derives meaningful length and rejects nonzero/excess padding
grammar.limits: Length header and padding are counted. Grammar is externally fixed. No magic/version/checksum/public-container wrapper is claimed. These are isolated mathematical frames, not CIX archives.

search.rational: Enumerate reduced rationals with q<=1023; prune only when mandatory candidate bits exceed raw bits. This denominator cap is a declared search restriction, not global rational optimality.
search.power: For each k, evaluate floor integer-root(X) and its successor if it fits the base field; residual code length is monotonic in absolute residual, so neighboring powers suffice within this family.
search.generated: All 4 seeds, 16 offsets and 4 masks; deduplicate identical target outputs by shortest/lexicographic description.
search.selection: Minimum encoded bits including the common length header; tie-break lexicographically. Byte padding also reported. Retain literal fallback.
search.controls: Raw representation, directly coded same masks, leave-one-family-out costs, and mathematically ideal rank cost for each finite generated dictionary support. No strongest-compressor comparison.

inputs.exhaustive: All 65536 values with n=16, equal weight; no random sampling.
constructed_n256: generated seed=2, offset=7, zero mask and alternating01 mask
inputs.pseudo_random_null_n256: SHA256(b'CIX-feasibility-null-v1:' + one byte i), i=0..3. Deterministic tiny controls, not evidence about a random source population.

acceptance: Every chosen frame must decode without the input or side channels; all cases and failed assertions preserved. Do not promote a CIX route from synthetic or whole-universe findings.
release_gate: Unchanged. No real assets, production code, dependency installation, broad benchmark or closed-branch reopening.
